hedging_delta.evidence: Prior call had extensive earthquake-related uncertainty and lowered SAM forecast; current call is more declarative about strong demand and raised outlook.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided FY24 revenue growth 'low to mid-20%'; current raises to 'slightly above mid-20s percent', and gross margin guide up from 51-53% to 53.5-55.5%.

tone_delta.evidence: Language shifts from 'mild and gradual recovery' and lowered forecasts to 'strong growth year' and 'raising our full-year guidance'.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior call lowered SAM forecast citing weak consumer sentiment; current call cites 'strong AI and high-end smartphone related demand' increasing utilization vs three months ago.
